Purchase a recharge package by package ID to add credits to a ClickSend account. Before using this action, call 'Get Recharge Packages' to retrieve available package IDs and their pricing. This action requires a valid payment method configured on the account. In test/sandbox environments, this may return a payment gateway error if no payment method is configured. Common error responses: - 404 "Customer token not found": No payment method configured - 404 "Package not found": Invalid package ID - 401 "Authorization failed": Authentication issue

clientary.description: Tool to remove an existing payment from an invoice. Use when you need to permanently delete a payment record. WARNING: Deletions are permanent and not reversible.

Tool to remove a specific payment profile from a client's account. Use when you need to delete a payment profile. Note: Client must have an active payment integration with Stripe to manage payment profiles.

clover.description: Applies a configured merchant service charge or creates an ad-hoc order-fee line item on an order. Choose `mode` explicitly so Clover receives the matching body and route.
Create an authorization for a payment. This has financial consequences and is not safely retryable without first checking whether Clover created the authorization.
Creates a vaulted credit or debit card record for a customer. `first6` and `last4` are required.
Records an externally processed payment on an order for bookkeeping; it does not process a Clover credit or debit payment. Requires a positive amount and merchant tender ID.
Permanently removes a configured service charge or order-fee line item from an order. Verify `mode`, `order_id`, and `service_charge_id` before calling; the removal is destructive.
Updates a customer's vaulted credit or debit card record. `first6` and `last4` are required.
Update payment line-item allocations or the employee on an uncaptured preauthorization. Other fields are ignored. Verify the payment after an uncertain result before retrying.

coinbase_agents_mcp.description: Executes a previously quoted conversion using the quote_id from convert_quote. This moves funds at the quoted rate — get a fresh quote first since quotes expire. The from/to currencies must match the original quote. (3 fields, 3 required)

Places a market order to flatten an open position for a product, moving funds immediately. Omit size for a full close or set it for a partial close. Preview the equivalent order first if fee or slippage impact matters. (3 fields, 2 required)

Place a market, limit, stop_limit, bracket, twap, or scaled order, subject to venue eligibility. Equities: use market or limit. Spot brackets require SELL; for entry, use market/limit BUY with attached exits. Futures brackets support BUY/SELL. Bracket stops become aggressive limit exits; fills and loss limits are not guaranteed. TWAP requires base_size, start_time, end_time, and a positive limit_price; slice count is automatic. Use orders_preview for optional fee, fill, and execution-plan estimates. Set exactly one size: limit and market SELL convert quote_size to base_size; market BUY spends quote_size; stop_limit/bracket/twap/scaled require base_size. Attached exits require market/limit parents and activate as the parent fills, including partial fills. If a FUTURE order is rejected for account eligibility, direct the user to https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/trading-and-funding/derivatives/futures-intro to apply. (24 fields, 3 required)

Atomically update an open order's price or size without cancelling. Omit attached fields to keep existing exits. Attach or change exits only on eligible unfilled limit orders: spot BUY or futures BUY/SELL, not equities. Exits activate as the parent fills, including partial fills. Stops become aggressive limit exits; fills and loss limits are not guaranteed. Attached updates replace both legs: send attached_take_profit_price and attached_stop_loss_price to keep both, even when changing one. Read orders_get first: attached_order_configuration.trigger_bracket_gtc.limit_price maps to attached_take_profit_price; stop_trigger_price maps to attached_stop_loss_price. cancel_attached_order removes both legs, but may be rejected after an exit activates. (6 fields, 1 required)

Moves funds of a single currency from one portfolio to another. This executes immediately and moves money — verify the source has sufficient available balance first. Both portfolio UUIDs come from portfolios_list. (4 fields, 4 required)

Fetches a resource returned by x402_resources. On a 402 challenge, pays from the caller's custodial Base USDC via a pre-authorized hold, then retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE — no manual challenge handling. All currently supported x402 purchases through this connector use Base USDC, and max_amount uses its 6-decimal atomic units; for example, "50000" means "0.05 USDC". This tool accepts only resource URLs returned by x402_resources. max_amount is the spend control; when the user has requested the data or stated a budget, proceed in a single call rather than re-confirming. Protocol v2 only; v1 challenges are rejected. (6 fields, 1 required)

Turns an x402 PaymentRequirements challenge into a ready-to-send payment header by placing a pre-authorized hold on the caller's Base USDC balance (EIP-3009 exact scheme, v0). All currently supported x402 purchases through this connector use Base USDC, and amount and max_amount use its 6-decimal atomic units; for example, "50000" means "0.05 USDC". Attach the returned header as X-PAYMENT for v1 or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for v2. This authorizes moving funds up to max_amount — pass the smallest amount that satisfies the requirement. Funds-touching and gated internal-only behind a default-off feature flag. (12 fields, 7 required)

coinbase_wallet_mcp.description: Swap between tokens on a mainnet chain (testnets not supported). Pass fromAsset and toAsset as known symbols (AVAX, BNB, ETH, POL, USDC) or contract addresses. Use search_tokens to discover an address for a token referenced by name. Amount is a decimal string (e.g. "0.5"). Returns approvalUrl for the user to confirm the swap in their Base Account. When telling the user where to approve, refer to the destination as "Base Account". Poll get_request_status(requestId) to verify completion before reporting success.

constant_contact.description: Update the payment status for event track registrations in Constant Contact. Use this action when you need to update the payment status for one or more registrations of an event track. This is commonly used to mark registrations as paid, pending, refunded, or failed after processing payments. The action requires the event ID, track ID, the new payment status, and a list of registration IDs to update. Note: Some registrations may fail to update while others succeed (207 Multi-Status). Check the response results for details on each registration update outcome.

coupa.description: Tool to add a file attachment to an existing purchase order. Use when you need to upload and attach files (documents, images, PDFs, etc.) to purchase orders in Coupa.
Tool to add a file attachment to a purchase order line. Use when you need to upload and attach files (documents, images, PDFs, etc.) to specific purchase order lines in Coupa.
Tool to create an external purchase order. Use when integrating external POs via Coupa API.
Tool to create payment reconciliation lines for a pay order in Coupa. Use when you need to record payment transactions against payable orders or invoices.
Tool to create a payment term in Coupa. Use when you need to define new payment conditions including discount and net payment calculations for invoices and purchase orders.
Delete an inventory transfer by ID. The response includes the HTTP status and accepts a 404 as well as a successful deletion response.
Tool to issue a purchase order without transmitting it to the supplier. Use when purchase orders are communicated through alternative means outside of Coupa's transmission channels.
Set a Coupa charge's exported flag, defaulting to exported. Use it to flag a charge as exported to an external accounting system or clear the flag.
Set the exported flag on a Coupa Pay payment by ID, defaulting to true. When an empty response is requested and returned, the result contains the supplied payment ID and exported flag.
Set the exported flag on a Coupa Pay invoice by ID, defaulting to true. Use after processing an invoice in an external system.

Tool to update a purchase order. Use when you need to modify specific fields of an existing PO. Only fields provided will be updated. Note: exported field cannot be updated simultaneously with other fields by default.
Tool to issue and send a purchase order to the supplier. Use after preparing a PO to dispatch it.
Tool to release a purchase order from buyer hold status. Use when you need to transition a PO from buyer_hold to an active state, allowing further processing.
Tool to update an existing payment term in Coupa. Use when you need to modify payment term attributes after confirming the payment term ID.
Tool to update a payable order status to ready to pay. Use when you need to transition a payable order to a 'ready to pay' status for payment processing.
Tool to update a purchase order change with remote approver information. Use when you need to modify a pending PO change request by providing the current approver's login.

Tool to withdraw signatures from a contract in Coupa Contract Center (CCC). Use when you need to move a contract to the corresponding status after CCC signature withdrawal. The contract must be in 'pending_signatures' status for this operation to succeed.
Tool to withdraw a dispute on an invoice. Use when a disputed invoice needs to be returned to the approval process due to supplier inaction or a mistake on the buyer side.

crawl4ai.description: Create an account-specific Stripe checkout flow for a Crawl4AI paid plan. This only returns a checkout URL: it does not directly charge a card or start the plan. Open and pay the Stripe checkout URL to complete the subscription. Use GET_PRICES_AND_PLANS first for current plan names and prices.

Immediately charge the saved card for the connected account's paid Crawl4AI plan and add non-expiring extra credits. This is a real, irreversible card charge, not a checkout flow. Call only after the user explicitly approves the exact US-dollar amount and set confirm_charge=true.

creem.description: Create a product in the connected Creem production store for a one-time payment, free purchase, or subscription. This is a live financial mutation: a successful call creates a purchasable product. Use idempotency_key for safe retries.

Experimental Creem API: irreversibly deduct credits from a customer credit account in the connected production store and create a live ledger transaction. Confirm the account, amount, and reference before calling. For retries, reuse the same idempotency key so an uncertain prior attempt cannot become a duplicate debit.

Issue an irreversible full refund of a payment's entire remaining refundable amount using its transaction ID. Partial refunds are not supported. Confirm the transaction before calling. A `pending` or `requiresAction` response is non-terminal and means provider processing continues asynchronously.

Update at least one field on a product in the connected Creem production store. Only supplied fields change; pricing, currency, billing, and tax changes affect future purchases, and changing the price creates a new default price.
Update items, units, seats, or add-ons on a Creem production subscription. This changes live recurring billing; proration-charge-immediately can charge the customer immediately.

Upgrade a subscription to a different product or plan in Creem production. This changes live billing and may charge the customer: the default update behavior applies proration and can charge it immediately.

deel.description: Assign workers to IT seats, with optional automatic purchase of missing seats when the subscription has insufficient free seats.
Attach entries to On-Demand Payroll. Calls Deel's documented PATCH /on-demand-payroll/{odp_id}/entries/attach Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Cancel On-Demand Payroll. Calls Deel's documented POST /on-demand-payroll/{odp_id}/cancel Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Add off-cycle payment. Calls Deel's documented POST /contracts/{contract_id}/off-cycle-payments Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Create On-Demand Payroll. Calls Deel's documented POST /on-demand-payroll/contract/{contract_id} Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Create a Deel payment statement for up to 100 invoices and initiate payment. This is an irreversible financial operation; use a unique idempotency key.
Create a work statement payment policy. Calls Deel's documented POST /work-statement-payment-policies Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Detach entries from an On-Demand Payroll, moving selected entries to regular payroll or permanently deleting selected entries.

Add payroll migration files to a legal entity. Each upload claim token must come from Deel's POST /files response for the matching file_id; it claims only that initialized file. Calls Deel's documented POST /gp/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/payroll-migration-imports Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Submit Global Payroll amendment signature. Calls Deel's documented POST /contracts/{contract_id}/amendments/{amendment_id}/sign Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Submit On-Demand Payroll. Calls Deel's documented POST /on-demand-payroll/{odp_id}/submit Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Submit a payroll migration import for review. Calls Deel's documented POST /gp/legal-entities/{legal_entity_id}/payroll-migration-imports/{import_id}/submit Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Sync time-off requests from an external HRIS to Deel Global Payroll, including inserting, updating, or deleting requests. Calls POST /time_offs/global-payroll/sync using Organization OAuth.
Assign asset to new holder. Calls Deel's documented POST /it/assets/{asset_id}/transfer Organization OAuth candidate operation.
Update contract payment type. Calls Deel's documented PATCH /contracts/{contract_id}/platform-payment Organization OAuth candidate operation.

deputy.description: Change the connected employee's pending bids on the specified rosters to withdrawn. Verify the roster IDs before updating them.
Request, cancel, accept, recommend, decline, or decline all for the specified roster swap. Verify the roster ID and selected operation before updating it.
Run Deputy's documented HR payroll synchronization operation for the specified employee; verify payroll inputs before running.

dialpad.description: Sends a request to Dialpad's OAuth token endpoint. The action does not accept an authorization code, refresh token, or grant type as input.

Transfers an active call within the Dialpad system to a new destination. This endpoint allows for flexible call routing by enabling transfers to another ongoing call, a specific phone number, or a predefined target within the Dialpad ecosystem (such as a call center, department, office, or user). It provides options to specify the transfer state and attach custom data to the call. Use this endpoint when you need to programmatically redirect an ongoing call, implement call forwarding logic, or integrate Dialpad's call transfer functionality into your application's workflow. Note that the success of the transfer may depend on the availability and settings of the destination.

digital_humani.description: CHARGEABLE PRODUCTION PURCHASE: create a real tree-planting request at $1 per tree. Use this tool only after the user explicitly authorizes the purchase and its exact tree_count; never use it for testing or infer a quantity.

disqus.description: Update an organization's payment information using the supplied payment token. Caveats: Looks up an organization by ID You must be an admin on the selected organization. The official action page does not identify a billing tier; availability remains capability/account dependent. This SaaS/billing action may require organization billing capability even though the page does not name a paid tier.

docusign.description: Deletes a specific envelope transfer rule from a DocuSign account. This endpoint allows account administrators to remove previously created rules that automatically transfer ownership of envelopes between users. It should be used when a transfer rule is no longer needed or requires updating. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone, so caution should be exercised. This endpoint requires administrator privileges and the "Transfer Custody" feature to be enabled for the account. It will not provide information about the deleted rule or affect existing transferred envelopes.

Posts a payment to past due invoices for a DocuSign account. This action applies a payment amount to settle outstanding invoice balances and creates a payment transaction record. Before using this action, retrieve past due invoice information using the 'List Past Due Invoices' action to get the total balance due and verify that 'paymentAllowed' is true. The payment amount must exactly match the 'pastDueBalance' value from that response. This action requires account administrator privileges and the 'billing:write' OAuth scope. It is only available for production accounts with billing features enabled - demo accounts will return a 400 Bad Request error with 'BILLING_PLAN_ERROR' indicating the payment manager is blocked. Use this when you need to programmatically settle overdue DocuSign account invoices through the REST API.

This endpoint completes the purchase of additional envelopes for a DocuSign account through an internal workflow interaction with an envelope vendor. It is designed to handle the financial transaction and update the account's envelope quota. This tool should be used when there's a need to increase the number of available envelopes for document signing within a DocuSign account. However, it's important to note that this endpoint is currently limited to DocuSign internal use only and is not available for public API consumers. The endpoint requires detailed information about the purchase, including the amount, currency, quantity, and app store-related data for tracking and processing the transaction.

Updates document visibility settings for multiple recipients in a DocuSign envelope. Use this action to control which documents each recipient can see and their access level (read-only or editable). This is essential for managing multi-document envelopes where different recipients should only access specific documents. Key features: - Set visibility for multiple document-recipient pairs in one request - Control access rights: read-only or editable - Hide documents from specific recipients (if no tabs assigned) Important limitations: - Documents with tabs assigned to a recipient cannot be hidden from that recipient - Some recipient types (Carbon Copy, Certified Delivery, Editor, Agent) always see all documents - The envelope must be in a state that allows modifications (typically 'created' status) Example use case: In a purchase agreement with financial disclosures, you might want the buyer to see the main agreement and their financial documents, while hiding the seller's confidential financial information.

dynatrace.description: Transfer a document to a new owner. Only the current owner can perform this operation, and the previous owner loses access after the transfer.
Transfer a Dynatrace settings object to a user, group, or all users. Only the owner or a main administrator can transfer ownership.

elastic_email.description: Add or remove email credits from a managed Elastic Email subaccount. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan. The signed adjustment is not idempotent; a retry can apply the adjustment twice.

elevenlabs.description: Tool to import/register a Twilio phone number or SIP trunk into ElevenLabs Agents Platform. Use when you need to provision a phone number for outbound calls and ELEVENLABS_GET_AGENT_DETAILS returns empty phone_numbers. This does NOT purchase a new number; it imports an existing provider configuration into your ElevenLabs workspace.

Submit an open production order with at least one item for processing. Submission charges the workspace and prevents further item modifications. To review the quote first, poll the order details until the quote is ready. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

era_context_mcp.description: List, confirm, or reject detected transfer links between the user's accounts. Transfer links are automatically detected when matching debit/credit transactions appear across different accounts (exact or near-match amounts within 3%). Use 'list' to see all detected transfers. Use 'confirm' when the user verifies a detected transfer is correct (upgrades confidence to 100%). Use 'reject' when a detected transfer is a false positive (removes the link and prevents re-detection). Transfer-tagged transactions are automatically excluded from spending and income analytics to prevent double-counting.

erpnext.description: Create a draft Purchase Order from an existing Material Request in ERPNext. Use when you need to initiate procurement of items from an approved material request. The created Purchase Order will be in draft state and can be modified before submission.

esignatures.description: Irreversibly withdraw an active unsigned contract so it can no longer be signed. The retained contract remains queryable.

esignatures_io.description: Tool to withdraw a contract by its ID. Use when you need to prevent further signing of a contract that hasn't been fully signed.

esputnik.description: Tool to transfer orders in bulk to eSputnik. Use when you need to import up to 1000 orders at once.

Tool to generate events in eSputnik v3 API. Use when you need to track custom events for contacts (e.g., purchase, cart abandoned, page viewed). Events can be used to trigger automated campaigns and for creating dynamic content in messages. Each event must have an eventTypeKey identifier. Contact identification must be provided in the params object using standard contact identifiers (email, phone, or externalCustomerId). Additional event parameters can also be included in params. Note: This is the v3 API endpoint. For legacy integrations, v1 is available but deprecated.

eventbrite.description: Tool to update ticket buyer settings for an Eventbrite event. Use when you need to configure post-purchase redirect URL, survey/registration form name, survey time limit, or specify who should fill out the survey (each attendee or just the ticket buyer).

eventzilla.description: Tool to confirm an event order by checkout ID and event ID. Use when you need to confirm a pending order and optionally send a confirmation email to the buyer.

faraday.description: Tool to create a new outcome. Outcomes are predictions about customer behavior such as likelihood to convert, churn, or purchase specific products. Use when you need to create a new predictive model.

finerworks.description: Tool to submit up to five new orders. Use after all customer and line-item details are finalized.

fingertip.description: Tool to create a store invoice in Fingertip. Use when you need to bill a customer for products or services with line items, pricing, and tax details. Returns the created invoice ID which can be used to retrieve or manage the invoice.

finmei.description: Attempts to delete a payment record by its unique identifier. A success response can also be returned after a 404, so it does not necessarily confirm deletion.

finmo.description: Create a Finmo customer profile containing personal or company identity data; this may start compliance workflows but does not itself move money. The API key determines whether the profile is created in production or sandbox.

Create a payout from a Finmo wallet to a beneficiary, which can reserve and irreversibly transfer funds. The API key determines whether the request uses production or sandbox; cross-currency requests require an FX rate ID and a timeout may leave the outcome uncertain.

Create a payout beneficiary with sensitive bank, proxy, identity, and contact details for use in later payouts, without itself moving money. The API key determines whether the beneficiary is created in production or sandbox; activation may take 24 hours.
Create a full refund request for a completed Finmo payin, which may debit or hold wallet funds, incur fees, and be irreversible. The API key determines whether the request uses production or sandbox.

Transfer funds between two Finmo wallets; depending on the credentials used, this may move real production funds and may be irreversible. Use a unique idempotency key for each transfer, and check transfer and transaction state after an ambiguous failure before retrying.

firmao.description: Creates a new sales or purchase invoice in Firmao CRM. This action generates an invoice transaction with line items, customer information, pricing details, and payment terms. It can auto-create customers if needed and supports automatic invoice numbering.

flutterwave.description: Tool to cancel a payment plan. Use when you need to prevent all future subscriptions under this plan.

Tool to create a bulk tokenized charge batch for charging multiple previously tokenized cards. Use when you need to process multiple recurring or subscription charges in a single batch. Each charge must reference a valid card token obtained from prior tokenization.
Tool to create a hosted payment link. Use when you need a shareable payment URL for one-time transactions.
Tool to create a new payment plan. Use after confirming plan and customer details.
Tool to create a refund for a transaction. Use when you need to initiate a refund after confirming the transaction ID and refund amount.
Tool to disable a Flutterwave payment link. Use when you need to prevent further payments from an existing link after confirming the link is valid.
Tool to update an existing payment plan. Use when you need to modify a payment plan's name or status.

fly.description: Tool to add a WireGuard peer connection to a Fly.io organization for private network access. Use when setting up VPN access or private networking between your infrastructure and Fly.io.
Tool to create a delegated WireGuard token for peer management in a Fly.io organization. Use when you need to generate a token for managing WireGuard peers with delegated access.

Tool to delete a delegated WireGuard token from a Fly.io organization. Use when you need to revoke or remove an existing WireGuard token that was previously created. Either token or name must be provided to identify which token to delete.
Tool to remove a WireGuard peer connection from a Fly.io organization. Use when you need to delete or revoke an existing WireGuard peer from your organization's network.

freee.description: Act On Payment Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Act On Purchase Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
取引（収入・支出）の支払行の作成
Create Payment Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Create Purchase Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Create Transfer using the official freee Accounting API contract.
取引（収入・支出）の支払行の削除
Delete Payment Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Delete Purchase Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Delete Transfer using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Call the official freee HR operation to put yearend adjustment payroll and bonus.
取引（収入・支出）の支払行の更新
Call the official freee HR operation to update employee basic pay rule.
給与明細の備考の更新
Update Payment Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Update Purchase Request using the official freee Accounting API contract.
Update Transfer using the official freee Accounting API contract.

gelato.description: Create a production order that can immediately enter fulfillment and charge the connected account. IRREVERSIBLE: call only after explicit purchase authorization, use a unique order_reference_id, and never retry an ambiguous result.

Convert an existing draft into a regular production order. CRITICAL: this is an irreversible, potentially payable transition that can start production. If items are supplied, every omitted existing item is removed; include ID-only entries for items that must remain unchanged. Never retry blindly.

getresponse.description: Create an ecommerce order and trigger matching Make a purchase workflows unless additional_flags is skipAutomation.

gift_up.description: Add a note of up to 500 characters to an existing order for internal tracking. The action then retrieves the order and returns its last note; the note may be added even if that follow-up retrieval fails.

Redeem a specified currency amount or units from a gift card. Voided cards or cards with insufficient balance cannot be redeemed; the response may contain redemption error flags instead of a successful transaction.
Tool to redeem a gift card in full. Use when you need to deduct the entire remaining balance from a gift card in a single operation.
Top up an existing gift card by code, supplying a positive currency amount and optionally units. Voided gift cards cannot be topped up.

github.description: Initiates a repository transfer to a new owner (who must accept the request); if the new owner is an organization, it must be configured to allow transfers.

gitlab.description: Move a GitLab project to another namespace. GitLab may complete the namespace move asynchronously after accepting the transfer.

gocardless_mcp.description: Permission required: payments:write. Ask the user to reconnect GoCardless and grant this permission to enable this tool.
Permission required: payments:write. Ask the user to reconnect GoCardless and grant this permission to enable this tool.
Permission required: payment_links:write. Ask the user to reconnect GoCardless and grant this permission to enable this tool.
Permission required: payment_links:write. Ask the user to reconnect GoCardless and grant this permission to enable this tool.
Permission required: refunds:write. Ask the user to reconnect GoCardless and grant this permission to enable this tool.

goodapi_plant_trees.description: Irreversibly refund all or part of an eligible tree planting from the current billing cycle and reduce active totals. Omit count for a full refund; reuse the same idempotency key only for an identical retry.

google_business_profile.description: Transfer a Google Business Profile location to another account administered by the connected user. High-consequence ownership move: confirm both resource names before calling; this can disrupt management access and is not automatically reversible.

google_classroom.description: Withdraw a pending guardian invitation by setting state to COMPLETE with updateMask=state. Only the PENDING to COMPLETE transition is permitted. Requires permission to manage guardians and guardians enabled for the domain; fails for non-pending invitations, invalid updates, or missing students or invitations.

googlebigquery.description: Tool to create a new capacity commitment resource in BigQuery Reservation. Use when you need to purchase compute capacity (slots) with a committed period of usage for BigQuery jobs. Supports various commitment plans (FLEX, MONTHLY, ANNUAL, THREE_YEAR) and editions (STANDARD, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_PLUS).

gosquared.description: Track custom events in GoSquared analytics. Use to record user actions like signups, purchases, button clicks, or any custom event. Events are associated with visitors/people and appear in their activity feeds and analytics dashboards.

Track e-commerce transactions in GoSquared analytics. Use this when a customer completes a purchase to record the transaction details including items purchased, revenue, and customer identification. The transaction ID must be unique - GoSquared uses this to prevent duplicate transactions. If the same transaction ID is sent again, the duplicate will be ignored. Transaction data appears in the GoSquared Ecommerce dashboard and can be associated with People profiles for customer analytics.

gumroad.description: Verify a Gumroad license key against a product and retrieve its usage count and purchase details. Verification increments the license uses count by default; it can be disabled.

gusto.description: Tool to add employees to a company's holiday pay policy in Gusto. Use when you need to add one or more employees to the holiday pay policy scope.

Tool to assign employees to pay schedules in Gusto. Use when you need to set up or update which pay schedule employees follow. For single assignments, provide default_pay_schedule_uuid. For by_employee or by_department assignments, use partial_assignment=true for partial updates or false for full assignments.
Tool to create a holiday pay policy for a company in Gusto. Use when you need to define which federal holidays will be paid holidays for a company's employees.

Tool to preview employee pay schedule assignment changes for a company. Use when you need to see how changing pay schedules will affect employees' pay periods and transition periods before applying the changes.
Tool to delete a company's holiday pay policy in Gusto. Use when you need to remove the holiday pay policy for a company.

Tool to preview pay schedule dates with specified parameters for the next 18 months. Use when you need to see upcoming pay dates, pay periods, and bank holidays for a proposed pay schedule configuration before creating it.
Tool to remove employees from a company's holiday pay policy in Gusto. Use when you need to exclude specific employees from the holiday pay policy scope.

Tool to update a contractor's payment method in Gusto. Use when you need to change how a contractor receives payments (Check or Direct Deposit). For Direct Deposit, you'll need to configure bank account splits separately.

Tool to update an employee's payment method in Gusto. Use when you need to change how an employee receives payments (Check or Direct Deposit). For Direct Deposit, you must also specify split_by and splits to configure bank account distribution.
Tool to update a company's holiday pay policy in Gusto. Use when you need to configure which federal holidays are included in the company's holiday pay policy.
Tool to update a pay schedule in Gusto. Use when you need to modify pay schedule settings such as custom name, anchor dates, frequency, or auto-payroll configuration.
Tool to update an existing recurring reimbursement in Gusto. Use when you need to modify the amount or description of a recurring reimbursement. Requires the current version for optimistic locking.

halopsa.description: Create or update HaloPSA invoice records and their typed line items. This action does not capture payment, post or email invoices, create credit notes, or trigger accounting-system synchronization.

happy_scribe.description: Tool to confirm a pending order. Use after creating an order with confirm=false when you're ready to submit it for processing.

harvest.description: Tool to create a new payment on an invoice. Use when recording a payment against an existing invoice.
Tool to delete an invoice payment. Use when you need to remove a payment from an invoice after confirming payment details.

harvey.description: Generate one non-streaming Harvey Assistant response from a prompt with optional documents or knowledge sources, matter attribution, model selection, and citations. This API requires an additional paid workspace purchase. Its documented contract and permissions have not been live-verified.

hibob.description: Creates a new variable pay entry for the employee.
Deletes a variable pay entry for the given employee.
Updates an existing variable pay entry for the given employee.

highlevel_location.description: API to manage auto payment for a schedule. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This may charge the contact's configured payment method. This may create, change, or cancel future billing activity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

Create or update a text-to-pay invoice for the connected HighLevel location in draft or send mode. HighLevel ignores the title, terms notes, and sent-to details for this operation. Location private integration tokens must have the `invoices.write` permission.

Replace payment-method settings on an invoice template in the connected Location using a Location private integration token provisioned with `invoices.write`. Confirm the intended bank-debit behavior before calling.
Create a real wallet charge for the connected HighLevel Location. The Location and its parent Company are resolved from the OAuth connection, and explicit confirmation is required.
Delete a wallet charge. This is a destructive billing operation with real wallet consequences and requires explicit confirmation.

Create a promotional coupon for the connected Location; future-payment configuration requires the future-payments flag to be true. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.write`.

Create a custom payment-provider association for the connected Location. Review all external URLs and subscription support before creating financial infrastructure. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

Create a Location payment-provider integration backed by Authorize.net or NMI. Review the provider, public URLs, and Location before creating financial infrastructure. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/integration.write`.

Create fulfillment history for an order. Confirm order, item quantities, tracking data, and whether a customer notification should be sent before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.write`.

Set whether the connected Location's custom payment provider supports subscription schedules. Confirm downstream recurring-billing behavior before disabling support. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

Permanently delete a coupon. This cannot be undone; confirm the exact coupon ID and that no active promotion should continue before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.write`.

Permanently delete the connected Location's custom payment-provider association; this can stop payment processing. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

Disconnect a custom provider's live or test payment configuration. Disconnecting live mode can stop charges and subscriptions; confirm the Location, mode, and operational impact before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

Record a real manual payment against an order. This changes financial balances and may mark the order paid; confirm the order ID, amount, currency, payment method, and partial-payment intent before calling. Do not use this action to test connectivity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.collectPayment`.

Replace an existing coupon's promotional terms; future-payment configuration requires future payments to be enabled. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission `payments/coupons.write`.

Purchase a phone number for the connected HighLevel location from external provider inventory. This can incur an immediate charge. Explicit confirmation is required, and this toolkit surface has no action for releasing the number. HighLevel rejects purchases when the location is not KYC verified, including when skip_location_kyc is true. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `phonenumbers.write`.

The Update Inventory API allows the user to bulk update the inventory for multiple items. Use this endpoint to update the available quantity and out-of-stock purchase settings for multiple items in the inventory. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.write`.

iterable.description: Track a purchase event in Iterable. Use when you need to record a purchase transaction. This action tracks purchase events, clearing the shoppingCartItems field on the user profile. The user profile is updated if it already exists, or created otherwise. Note that there is a soft limit of 1,000 unique fields per user, and field types must remain consistent across all requests in the project. The total amount must match the sum of items (price × quantity), though this is not enforced by the API. If an optional purchase ID is provided and a purchase with that ID already exists, the purchase will be updated instead of creating a new one.

jibble.description: Dangerously change a pay period to Approved, Reopened, or Rejected. This approval decision locks or unlocks its time records as Jibble defines; confirm the pay period and intended status before calling.

kajabi.description: Cancel the Stripe, PayPal, or Kajabi Payments subscription associated with a Kajabi purchase and deactivate the purchase after explicit confirmation. Cancellation is immediate according to the payment provider's rules, can stop future billing, removes product access, and may be irreversible.
Deactivate a Kajabi purchase after explicit confirmation, removing the customer's associated product access. This does not cancel an associated subscription, so subscription billing may continue.

Reactivate a deactivated Kajabi purchase after explicit confirmation, restoring the customer's purchase access. This changes customer access state but does not reactivate or resume an associated subscription.

kernel.description: Click at browser viewport coordinates with an optional mouse button, click phase, modifiers, and repetition count. A click can submit forms, place orders, or cause other irreversible external effects.

kit.description: Record or update an external purchase for a Kit subscriber. Requires OAuth 2.0 authentication; API keys are not supported. Kit creates an active subscriber when the email address is unknown and creates products that do not yet exist automatically. This operation is not safely idempotent: Kit matches a transaction_id to update an existing purchase, but appends products as new line items. Repeating a request with the same products duplicates those line items, so send only products not already synced for that transaction.

Creates a webhook subscription for real-time event notifications. Use this to receive HTTP POST notifications when subscriber events (activate, unsubscribe, form subscribe, tag add/remove, link clicks, etc.) or purchase events occur in your Kit account.

klarna.description: Append shipping carrier and tracking information to a Klarna order.
Irreversibly capture all or part of an authorized Klarna order and return the created capture ID.
Create a reusable Klarna customer token from a payment authorization token for subscription purchases.
Create a Klarna order from a customer authorization token. When order.auto_capture is true, Klarna also captures payment automatically.
Create a Klarna order using a reusable customer token. Setting auto_capture to true captures the payment automatically.
Create a Klarna Payments session and return its session ID, sensitive client token, and available payment method categories.
Irreversibly create a full or partial Klarna refund and return the created refund ID.

Update mutable data on an existing Klarna Payments session, including order amounts and lines, customer and billing or shipping addresses, merchant references and URLs, purchase locale and currency, payment options, and session intent. Klarna returns no session data after a successful update.

lexoffice.description: Tool to create a bookkeeping voucher in Lexoffice. Use when you need to create expense receipts, sales invoices, purchase invoices, or other accounting vouchers. The voucher requires line items with amounts, tax rates, and posting category IDs.

linq.description: Irreversibly cancel a financial payment and close its virtual card. Confirm the payment identifier and authorization before calling because the canceled payment cannot be resumed.

Irreversibly cancel an unpaid payment request and its underlying payment intent. The checkout can no longer be completed after cancellation; paid, canceled, or expired requests cannot be canceled. Confirm the request ID and intent first.

Start the financial-consent ceremony for a customer phone number or email so an agent can later pay on that customer's behalf. This consent-sensitive, irreversible action may contact the customer and send an OTP; call it only with the customer's explicit consent.

Create or advance a real financial payment on a connected customer's behalf, potentially minting a single-use virtual card. This is consent-sensitive and financially consequential; obtain explicit customer authorization, verify the amount and merchant, and use an Idempotency-Key for retries.

Create a customer-facing checkout that can collect a one-time charge or start an auto-renewing subscription. This creates financial state but does not itself send the checkout URL to a recipient. Confirm the amount, currency, mode, rail, and intended payer before calling; use idempotency_key for retries.

Irreversibly revoke this partner's financial-consent grant for a customer phone number or email. This prevents future payments through the grant but does not delete the customer's provider wallet; revoke only with explicit authorization.

Create a hosted payment-provider onboarding session for the organization. This starts an external Stripe/Agentcard authorization flow and returns a sensitive hosted URL that an authorized administrator must open; do not use it to complete production onboarding without explicit administrative consent.

Submit a customer's single-use OTP to complete the financial-consent ceremony and authorize future payments on the customer's behalf. This irreversible, consent-sensitive action consumes the code and records consent; use only a code the customer explicitly provided for this connection.

longbridge_mcp.description: Submit a buy/sell order. DRY RUN unless execute is the confirmation_code from its own dry run: call once without execute, show the preview to the user, then re-call quoting the code only after they explicitly confirm.

loyverse.description: Tool to create a new supplier or update an existing one in Loyverse. Use when you need to register suppliers before purchases or modify supplier information. If the 'id' field is provided, it will update the existing supplier; otherwise, it creates a new supplier.

Tool to create a refund receipt for a sales receipt. Use when you need to process a refund for items from a previous sale. Only supports refunds for receipts paid by a single payment method (not integrated payments).

magic_hour.description: Start a credit-consuming asynchronous body-swap image job that places a person into a scene at the selected resolution. Resolution determines the model and credit cost. This returns an image project ID immediately, not a completed image; pass the ID to MAGIC_HOUR_GET_IMAGE_PROJECT and poll until status is complete or error. Credits are charged when this request is made and refunded if generation fails.

Start a credit-consuming asynchronous photo face swap using one source face for all detected faces or up to five individual face mappings. Each photo costs 10 credits. The operation returns an image project ID and credit charge immediately, not a completed image; poll MAGIC_HOUR_GET_IMAGE_PROJECT until status is complete or error.

Start a credit-consuming asynchronous video face-swap job using one image for all detected faces or up to five individual face mappings. The operation is documented for Free accounts but requires sufficient credits. It returns a project ID and estimated charge immediately, not a completed video; poll MAGIC_HOUR_GET_VIDEO_PROJECT until status is complete, error, or canceled.

Start a credit-consuming asynchronous head-swap image job from body and head images. Each image costs 10 credits. This returns an image project ID immediately, not a completed image; pass the ID to MAGIC_HOUR_GET_IMAGE_PROJECT and poll until status is complete or error. Credits are charged when this request is made and refunded if generation fails.

mailchimp.description: Add an event for a list member. Use this action to track contact activity and behavior outside of email campaigns. Events can be used for segmentation and triggering automation workflows. Common use cases: - Track purchases, signups, or page visits - Record custom milestones or achievements - Import historical events with is_syncing=true to avoid triggering automations Note: Returns 204 No Content on success (empty response body).

Add a new line item to an existing order in a Mailchimp e-commerce store. Prerequisites: The store, order, product, and product variant must already exist. Use MAILCHIMP_ADD_STORE, MAILCHIMP_ADD_ORDER, and MAILCHIMP_ADD_PRODUCT to create them first if needed.

mailerlite.description: Tool to create or update a customer record for a shop. Use when syncing shop customers or onboarding new purchases.
Tool to create a new order for a shop. Use when recording customer purchases or syncing order data from external systems.

maxio.description: Creates a one-time invoice for a subscription with custom line items. Use when you need to bill a customer for a one-time charge or custom amount that is not part of their regular subscription. The invoice can include multiple line items with titles, descriptions, quantities, and prices.
Creates a customer payment profile in Maxio (Chargify) using cardholder name, card number and expiration details. The response may include a vault token for future use.

Creates a quantity-based component for recurring units within a product family. Use when you need to add billing components that charge per unit based on quantity, such as user licenses, team seats, or device slots. Quantity-based components allow customers to purchase a variable number of units (e.g., 5 user licenses) with per-unit pricing that can be tiered.

Removes a payment profile from a subscription in Maxio Advanced Billing. Use when you need to unlink a credit card or payment method from a subscription, for example, when cleaning up obsolete payment profiles or replacing them with new ones. This action is irreversible — once the payment profile is removed from the subscription, it cannot be recovered through this endpoint.

Permanently deletes an unused payment profile from Maxio/Chargify. Use when you need to remove a payment profile that is no longer associated with any active subscriptions or payment references. This action is irreversible — once deleted, the payment profile cannot be recovered. Note: Only unused payment profiles can be deleted. Attempting to delete a profile that is currently in use (e.g., associated with an active subscription) will result in an error (422 Unprocessable Entity).

Issues a service credit to a subscription. Service credits are amounts that are added to a subscription's service credit balance and can be applied toward future invoices. Use this action when you need to compensate a customer, apply promotional credits, or add funds to a subscription's service credit balance. The credit will increase the subscription's available service credit balance.

Records a payment for an invoice. This action can be used to record both full and partial payments against an invoice. Use this action when you need to record a customer payment for an existing invoice. The payment will be applied to the invoice, updating its paid_amount and potentially changing its status to 'paid' if the full amount is received. Note: You can specify a payment method explicitly or let the system use the subscription's default payment profile.

Creates a refund for a paid invoice. Use this action when you need to process a refund for a customer whose invoice has already been paid. The refund will be recorded against the invoice and a credit note may be generated depending on your settings. This action is irreversible — once a refund is processed, it cannot be automatically reversed. Ensure you have verified the refund amount and reason before executing. Note: The invoice must be in a 'paid' state to process a refund.

Refunds a prepayment made on a subscription. This action is irreversible — once a prepayment is refunded, the refund cannot be undone. Use this action when a customer requests a refund for a prepayment, or when you need to reverse an incorrectly applied prepayment. The refund amount will be returned to the customer according to your refund policy. Note: You must provide either `amount` (decimal string) or `amount_in_cents` (integer), but not both. If the prepayment was made through a payment profile (non-external), the `external` flag should be set appropriately.

Sends an email to the customer requesting they update their payment method. Use when you need to prompt a customer to update their credit card or payment method on file. This is typically used when their current payment method is expiring, has been declined, or needs to be refreshed for any reason. The email will be sent to the billing email address associated with the subscription's customer account. The customer will receive a link to securely update their payment information through the billing portal. This action does not modify any subscription or payment data directly — it only triggers an email notification to the customer.

Updates an existing payment profile in Maxio (Chargify). Use when you need to modify an existing payment profile's details such as card information, billing address, or contact details. At least one field must be provided to update. Note: This action uses PUT which replaces the entire payment profile with the provided data. Only the fields you include in the request will be updated.

memelord.description: Start a paid Genjutsu job that transposes people or characters, or swaps an object or creature, in an existing video while retaining its motion, camera, timing, and audio. Poll the returned job ID for completion.

metronome.description: Complete or cancel a threshold commit after an external payment attempt.

moco.description: Tool to assign a purchase item to a project by creating or linking to an expense. Use when you need to associate a purchase line item with a specific project for billing and budget tracking.
Tool to create multiple invoice payments in bulk. Use when you need to record multiple payments at once across different invoices.
Tool to create a new invoice payment. Use when recording a payment received for an invoice.
Tool to create a payment schedule entry for a project. Use when you need to add a scheduled payment milestone to an existing project.
Tool to create a new purchase bookkeeping export. Use when you need to export purchases for bookkeeping or DATEV submission.
Tool to create a new purchase payment. Use when you need to record a payment made for a purchase or create a standalone payment entry with a description.
Tool to create multiple purchase payments in bulk. Use when you need to record multiple payments at once for efficiency.
Tool to delete an invoice payment. Use when you need to remove an invoice payment record from MOCO.
Tool to delete a payment schedule from a project. Use when you need to remove a scheduled payment milestone from an existing project.
Tool to delete a purchase. Use when you need to remove a purchase record that is in 'pending' status and has no registered payments.
Tool to delete a purchase payment. Use when you need to remove a payment record from a purchase.
Tool to selectively remove tags from an entity. Use when you need to remove specific tags from a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User.

Tool to partially update taggings by adding new tags to an entity without removing existing tags. Use when you need to append tags to a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User while preserving existing tags.
Tool to create a new purchase. Use when you need to log an expense record after gathering date, items, and payment info.
Tool to update a payment schedule entry for a project. Use when you need to modify an existing scheduled payment milestone for a project.
Tool to update an existing purchase. Use when you need to modify purchase details after confirming the purchase ID.

Tool to update or store a purchase document. Use when you need to attach a document file to an existing purchase or replace an existing document. The file is uploaded using multipart/form-data format.
Tool to update the status of a purchase. Use when you need to change a purchase status between pending and archived.
Replace all tags on a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User with a provided nonempty list of tags.

modelry.description: Tool to place an order for 3D modeling services. Use when workspace and product IDs are known and modeling specifications are ready.

money_forward.description: Create and persist one or more Cloud Accounting trade-partner master records in one batch. A successful call has a persistent side effect; the approved API surface provides no operation to update or delete these records.

moneybird.description: Register a payment against a Moneybird external sales invoice.
Tool to request a URL for setting up a Payments mandate. Use when you need to generate a direct-debit authorization link for a contact (valid for 14 days).

msg91.description: Create and track user events in MSG91 Segmento for customer behavior analysis and segmentation. Use this tool to record user actions and behaviors such as logins, purchases, page views, button clicks, or any custom events. These events help build user profiles and enable targeted campaigns based on user behavior. Examples: - Track user login events for engagement analysis - Record purchase events with product details for sales tracking - Log page views and clicks for behavior analytics - Capture custom events with properties for detailed segmentation

neon.description: Accepts a pending transfer request and irreversibly moves the Neon project to the authenticated account or specified organization. This consumes the request and changes project ownership. Confirm the destination before calling, and do not retry an ambiguous failure because the transfer may already have completed.

Creates a transfer request for a Neon project. The request expires after its configured validity period. Requires the `urn:neoncloud:orgs:delete` OAuth scope on the connection; it is not in the default scope set.

Transfers selected projects from one organization to another organization. Use this when you need to move projects between organizations, for example during organizational restructuring or mergers. Note that projects with GitHub or Vercel integrations cannot be transferred and will cause the request to fail. WARNING: The ownership transfer has no inverse endpoint. Verify the source organization, destination organization, and every project ID before calling, and do not retry an ambiguous failure because the transfer may already have completed. Requires the `urn:neoncloud:orgs:delete` OAuth scope on the connection; it is not in the default scope set.

Deprecated by Neon: personal accounts have been migrated to organizations, and Neon scheduled this endpoint for removal on July 1, 2026. For a still eligible account, this moves 1-400 projects from personal ownership to the destination organization; it does not delete project data. The ownership transfer has no inverse endpoint. Verify all project and organization IDs, and do not retry an ambiguous failure because the transfer may have completed.

netlicensing.description: Irreversibly transfer all eligible licenses from a source licensee marked for transfer to a target licensee in the same product.

netsuite.description: Creates a customer payment record in NetSuite, optionally linking it to invoices through the apply sublist. Supports asynchronous creation; the returned location may be an async job URL.
Tool to create a new purchase order record. Use when you need to submit a purchase order to a vendor.

Delete a customer payment record from NetSuite by its ID. Use this action to permanently remove a customer payment record. You can delete by internal ID (numeric) or external ID (prefixed with 'eid:'). This is a destructive operation and cannot be undone. Returns success=true on successful deletion (HTTP 204).
Tool to delete a purchase order record by ID. Use when you need to remove an existing purchase order from NetSuite.
Delete a vendor payment record by internal ID. The tool also reports success when the delete request receives a 404, so success does not necessarily confirm that a record was deleted.

Tool to update an existing customer payment by ID. Use when you need to modify fields of a customer payment record. Updates only the specified fields; all other fields remain unchanged. Common use cases include updating memo notes, email preferences, or transaction metadata.
Tool to update a purchase order record by ID. Use when modifying fields of an existing purchase order. Call after retrieving the record to confirm current values.
Tool to update a vendor payment record by ID. Use when modifying one or more fields on an existing vendor payment.

omnisend.description: Tool to create a new order in Omnisend v3 API. Use when recording a customer purchase or order transaction.

onesignal_user_auth.description: Transfer a push, email, or SMS subscription to another user in the same app. Use an App API key. OneSignal recommends SDK login instead where possible; ensure your app or website sets the same External ID. Cross-app transfers are not supported and push platform limitations may apply.

open_sea.description: Submit an offer to purchase a single NFT (ERC721 or ERC1155). The order parameters accepted by this tool contain only the order type; a signature and protocol address are also required.

openrouter.description: Tool to create a Coinbase charge for crypto payment to add credits to your OpenRouter account. Use when you need to purchase credits using cryptocurrency. Returns calldata needed to fulfill the transaction on the specified blockchain.

order_desk.description: Append a timestamped note permanently to an existing order's history. Order history is append-only, so this tool cannot edit or remove the entry.
Add one line item to an existing order.
Add two to 10 line items sequentially to the same order and return a result for every processed item. This batch is not atomic.

pandadoc.description: Transfer ownership of all documents. This method transfers ownership of all documents from one member to another.

paypal.description: Captures an outstanding balance on a PayPal subscription. Provide the subscription ID, amount, outstanding-balance capture type and a note explaining the charge.

Charges a payment method using the Braintree GraphQL API, creating a transaction and beginning settlement. Provide a tokenized payment method ID and transaction details; requests use the production Braintree endpoint.

Creates a PayPal payment using the v1 Payments API. Use this action when you need to create a payment to be processed through PayPal. This action is for the deprecated v1 API - consider using the v2 Payments API for new integrations. The action returns the created payment object including approval URLs for the buyer to complete the payment. After the buyer approves the payment, execute it to complete the transaction. Note: This is an irreversible operation once the payment is executed.

Creates a PayPal billing plan using the legacy payments API (POST /v1/payments/billing-plans). Use this action when setting up a new billing plan for PayPal billing agreements, including plans with trial periods, regular billing cycles, and custom payment preferences. After creation, the plan must be activated via the activate_plan action before it can be used in billing agreements. Note: This uses the legacy /v1/payments/billing-plans endpoint. For newer integrations, consider using the /v1/billing/plans endpoint instead.

Deletes an external payment record from a specified PayPal invoice. The tool reports success for a 204 response and also for any 404 response, so a success result alone does not confirm that a record was deleted.
Deletes a payment record from a PayPal invoice by invoice and transaction ID. The tool reports success for HTTP 204 and also for any HTTP 404 response.
Deletes an external refund record from a specified PayPal invoice using the deprecated Invoicing v1 API. This removes the record from the invoice rather than reversing the underlying payment.

Deletes a PayPal payment resource. Use when you need to permanently remove a payment resource that is no longer needed. This action is irreversible — the payment resource cannot be recovered once deleted. Note: Only payment resources in a valid state can be deleted. Attempting to delete a resource that is already deleted or does not exist will return an error.

Finalizes a Braintree dispute after adding evidence, submitting it to the cardholder's bank for review. Use this action when you have finished adding evidence to an OPEN dispute and want to formally submit it for review. Only disputes with a status of OPEN can be finalized. This action must be performed before the reply-by date deadline. Once finalized, the dispute cannot be modified or additional evidence added. Note: This action uses the Braintree GraphQL API endpoint, which is separate from the standard PayPal REST API.

Lists PayPal Payments v1 payments for reconciliation or monitoring, with pagination and optional time, payer, and status parameters. DEPRECATED: Payments v1 is intended for existing integrations and will be removed. Migrate payment listing to the Transaction Search API, which has a different query and response model.
Partially updates a PayPal product by ID using an array of JSON Patch operations. On a 204 response, it returns a success flag and product ID.

Updates a PayPal webhook using JSON Patch operations, including changes to its URL or event subscriptions. The response contains the updated webhook when returned, or the webhook ID on a no-content response.

Verifies a multi-use payment method to ensure it has passed fraud rules and is associated with a valid account. Use this action when you need to verify that a vaulted (multi-use) payment method is valid before using it for transactions. The verification runs the payment method through your configured Braintree fraud rules and confirms with the card issuer that the card is associated with a valid account. This action is commonly used when a customer adds a new payment method and you want to validate it, when checking if a stored payment method is still valid before a scheduled transaction, or as part of a risk management workflow to pre-validate payment methods. The response includes a verification status (VERIFIED, FAILED, GATEWAY_REJECTED, or PROCESSOR_DECLINED) along with processor response codes. Note: This action uses the Braintree GraphQL API endpoint at /graphql. The payment method must be a multi-use token that has been stored in the Braintree vault.

paystack.description: Tool to archive a payment request to clean up records. Use when you need to remove a payment request from active listings. An archived payment request cannot be verified and will not appear when listing payment requests.

Create multiple transfer recipients in batches. Use when you need to add multiple recipients at once for transfers. Duplicate account numbers automatically return existing recipient records instead of creating duplicates.
Tool to initiate a payment by integrating the payment channel of your choice. Use when you need to charge a customer using authorization code, bank account, mobile money, or USSD.
Tool to create a payment page on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to create a payment page that customers can visit to make payments.
Create a new payment request by issuing an invoice to a customer. Use this when you need to request payment from a customer for goods or services.

Tool to initiate a refund for a previously completed transaction on Paystack. Use when a customer requests a refund or when you need to reverse a payment. The refund can be for the full transaction amount or a partial amount.

Tool to create a new recipient for transfers. Use when you need to set up a recipient before initiating a transfer. Note: A duplicate account number will lead to retrieval of the existing record rather than creating a new one.
Tool to delete a transfer recipient by setting it to inactive status. Use when you need to remove a recipient from the active transfer list.
Tool to disable OTP requirement for programmatic transfers. Use when you want to complete transfers without OTP verification. Returns an OTP needed to finalize the request.
Tool to enable OTP requirement for transfers. Use when a customer wants to stop being able to complete transfers programmatically and require OTP verification instead.
Tool to finalize the creation of a draft payment request for a customer. Use when you need to convert a draft payment request into an active one that can be paid by the customer.
Tool to initiate a bulk charge on your integration. Use when you need to charge multiple customers at once using their authorization codes.
Tool to pause processing of a bulk charge batch. Use when you need to temporarily stop a bulk charge batch from processing further charges.
Tool to make a Storefront publicly available on Paystack. Use this when you need to publish a previously created storefront so that customers can access and purchase from it.
Tool to resend OTP for a transfer. Use when a customer is having trouble receiving their OTP and needs a new one sent to complete their transfer.
Tool to resume processing of a previously paused bulk charge batch. Use when you need to restart a paused bulk charge batch using its batch code.
Tool to send an email notification to a customer for a previously created payment request. Use when you need to remind a customer about an unpaid invoice or payment request.
Tool to trigger an activation charge on an inactive direct debit mandate for a customer. Use when a mandate needs to be reactivated or retried.
Tool to unregister a top-level domain or subdomain previously used for Apple Pay integration. Use when you need to remove a domain from your Apple Pay configuration.
Tool to update a payment page on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to modify details of an existing payment page such as name, description, amount, or active status.
Tool to update a payment request on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to modify details of an existing payment request such as amount, description, due date, or other attributes.
Tool to update the payment session timeout on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to change the duration before a payment session expires.
Tool to update the details of a transfer recipient. Use when you need to modify an existing recipient's name or email address.

photon_mcp.description:
Purchase SMS number

Buys one US local number from the provider and records it as a resource with SMS enabled. Requires countryCode (US) and accepts an optional three-digit geographic areaCode. The server selects an exact matching number. Empty inventory keeps the operation running until a number is available or the caller cancels before ordering begins. Always answers 202 with an operation: the work runs behind the response, and the Location points at the operation to poll. New area-specific requests must appear in current provider coverage; discover it with GET /sms/numbers/area-codes?countryCode=US. Coverage and subscription checks run before operation creation. Billing follows delivery. Replays return the original operation without checking current coverage. The Idempotency-Key is required and permanent: repeating it returns the same operation forever, never a second number. A further number always needs a NEW key, including while others are still running. Requires the platforms:write permission bound to the project resource in the path.

piggy.description: Tool to create a credit reception for a contact. Use when awarding credits to customers based on purchases or fixed amounts.

plaid.description: Cancel only after GET_TRANSFER showed transfer.cancellable=true and the caller explicitly confirms. This moves real money in production by changing its lifecycle. Once submitted to the payment network it cannot be canceled; RTP and FedNow are effectively immediate.

Irreversibly cancel an unused Plaid Transfer authorization after explicit confirmation. An authorization can be cancelled only before it is used. This does not cancel a created transfer; use CANCEL_TRANSFER for that lifecycle.

Create a European Payment Initiation payment intent for a previously created recipient. This can move real money after Link authorization. Explicit confirmation is required. The returned INPUT_NEEDED status is not payment completion. Do not retry after an ambiguous failure without first resolving whether a payment was created. Scheduled standing orders cannot be modified or canceled through the API after creation.

Create an unauthorised Payment Initiation consent for one recipient, with explicit per-payment and periodic limits. This does not move funds; the user must authorise the consent before it can execute payments.
Create or reuse a European Payment Initiation recipient from sensitive IBAN or Bacs destination details. This does not create a payment or move money.

Move money using an approved, unexpired, unused authorization_id. authorization_id must be the id returned by CREATE_TRANSFER_AUTHORIZATION. This action never authorizes implicitly. This moves real money in production. Verify every material term and explicitly confirm immediately before calling.

Authorize a proposed US Plaid Transfer and return the authorization decision. This does not itself move money, but can incur charges and count against limits. authorization_id is required by CREATE_TRANSFER. Proceed only when the decision is approved.

saperly.description: PAID / METERED — places a REAL outbound voice call that RINGS A REAL PHONE and BILLS PER MINUTE (~26¢/min); it keeps billing until hung up — end it with SAPERLY_END_CALL to stop the meter. Calls FROM a Saperly number (`fromNumberId` from SAPERLY_LIST_NUMBERS) TO an E.164 destination (`to`, e.g. +14155550123). The connection bound to the originating number answers; a number with NO bound connection cannot hold a conversation (bind one with SAPERLY_ASSIGN_NUMBER_CONNECTION). Optionally override the brain for this call with `connectionId` and/or a per-call `instructions` prompt. CONSENT GATE (TCPA): the destination MUST have active consent — call SAPERLY_RECORD_CONSENT first and SAPERLY_CHECK_CONSENT to verify, or it is rejected (403). Returns the call (201) with id + status; `durationSec`/`costCents` are NULL until the call settles (ends) — null does NOT mean it was free. Pass `idempotency_key` on retries to avoid double-dialing. May fail 402 (funds) or 422 (no connection).

PAID / METERED: provision (buy) a new phone number in a country. This SPENDS MONEY — it charges the workspace prepaid balance an upfront fee plus a RECURRING MONTHLY rent (US local ~ $1.79/mo, varies by country/type). Before calling this: (1) call SAPERLY_QUOTE_NUMBER_PRICE to get the live price and pass it as expectedMonthlyPriceCents / expectedUpfrontPriceCents to guard against price drift (a higher live price fails with 409 PriceChanged unless approveHigherPrice=true); (2) confirm sufficient funds by checking balanceCents via SAPERLY_GET_USAGE. Defaults country='US', numberType='local'. Pass an idempotency_key to avoid double-provisioning on retry. Fails 402 (InsufficientFunds / PaymentMethodRequired), 403 (CountryNotAvailable), 404 (NoNumbersAvailable), 409 (NumberQuotaExceeded / PriceChanged).

PAID / METERED: send a single SMS from one of your Saperly numbers to an E.164 destination. This SPENDS REAL MONEY and sends a REAL text message to a REAL phone (~2 cents per 160-character segment; a long body is split into multiple segments, each billed). TCPA CONSENT GATE (required): the API refuses to send unless the recipient has an active consent record (or messaged you within the last 24h). For cold outbound you MUST first call SAPERLY_RECORD_CONSENT for the destination, and you can verify it with SAPERLY_CHECK_CONSENT — otherwise this fails with 403 RecipientOptedOut / compliance. Before sending, confirm sufficient funds via SAPERLY_GET_USAGE (balanceCents). Pass idempotency_key to prevent a double-send on retry. Returns 201 with the queued message (id, status, segments). NOTE the response echoes the sending number as 'numberId' and 'from_number' (not 'fromNumberId'). Fails 402 (InsufficientFunds / SpendLimitExceeded), 400 (DestinationNotSupported / invalid request).

PAID / METERED — BLIND-transfers a LIVE, in-progress voice call to another destination `to` (an E.164 number like +15551230000, or a `sip:` URI). BLIND means the call is handed off UNCONDITIONALLY: there is NO confirmation from the transferee and the AI agent LOSES CONTROL of the call once transferred — treat it as a one-way, irrecoverable handoff. Only meaningful on a call that is actually connected/in-progress (identify it via SAPERLY_PLACE_CALL or SAPERLY_LIST_CALLS). The transferred leg KEEPS BILLING per minute, so this is not free — the meter runs on the new leg until the call ends. Returns the call object with its updated status; `durationSec` / `costCents` stay NULL until the call settles (null does NOT mean it was free). Pass `idempotency_key` on retries to avoid starting a second transfer leg. Fails 502 CallStartFailed if the transfer leg cannot be started, and 404 if the call id is unknown.
